review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Repair only independent87 F1/F2 consumers after actual main composition
review.notes: Full03387 report and five manifest entries SHA verified; original826/CI/logs preserved. F1 real SplitShell must consume shared read state including hidden sidebar and original automatic selection. F2 actual Provider-to-Panel cached failure, SSE live, pending reread and success must preserve error/timestamp/retry feedback. Malformed data is not proof of network unreachability. Preserve the lane, scope, guest/expired authorization, polling and Live Activity. Use the shared main placeholder without another list/banner/header; main may suppress a duplicate excerpt already shown in the sidebar. Shared OfflineBanner can accept a read cause and pending feedback, retaining default network behavior. Add separate regression files; do not edit or weaken old assertions. No new API, Go, dependency, native or device work.

cases.description: Actual regular shell main honors the current client read with a visible or hidden sidebar
cases.setup: Production SplitShell and shared read presentation, leaf sidebar/detail/HQ/browser mocked; explicit pending, timeout, failed, access, stale-share and successful states in both languages and palettes
cases.action: Render without selection before a read settles; hide sidebar; transition to a genuine empty or populated read; observe the existing automatic selection call
cases.expected: No empty/tutorial claim before a valid result. Shared loading/error/access/stale states remain in main even with sidebar hidden. Only successful empty shows welcome; a populated roster offers selection while original automatic selection runs. Guest creation stays unavailable; no duplicated list/banner/header or excerpt. Existing selected views remain unchanged.

cases.description: Actual Provider-to-Panel keeps cached failure feedback across SSE reconnection until read success
cases.setup: Production AgentsProvider/readTask/RadarPanel/OfflineBanner, controlled reads/SSE and cached worker/timestamp; malformed-like failure and complete-read timeout
cases.action: Succeed first read, fail refresh, reopen SSE while reread is pending, inspect rows/notice/time and retry feedback, succeed, then change client
cases.expected: SSE live alone cannot clear the read error, readable notice or last-update time. Cached rows remain visible/stale; malformed-like failure is not described as unreachable network. Pending retry is visible and duplicate retry disabled. Current successful read clears notice and updates time; a changed client inherits neither rows nor error. Access failure preserves owner settings or guest contact guidance without new authority.
